description_expanded: OverviewHot TubGulf Views - Rooftop deck - Private Poolside Cabana, Pool -Public Beach-5 Minute Walk `The Crest 9`The Space Luxurious Gulf-View Retreat – Private Cabana & Rooftop Spaces! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Panoramic Gulf Views – Stunning coastal scenery from multiple levels Private Poolside Cabana – Exclusive poolside retreat for ultimate relaxation Rooftop Gathering Area – Includes a built-in grill for outdoor entertaining Fire Pit & Private Patio – Cozy outdoor space for relaxing under the stars Media Room w/ Air Hockey & Video Games – Fun for kids & adults alike Elevator Access – Convenient access to all four floors 5 Adult Bikes Included – Explore 30A’s trails & local hotspots Second-Floor Office – Private work space with a quiet setting Two Sets of Washer/Dryers – Located on 2nd & 3rd floors for convenience YouTube TV & Streaming Access – Stay entertained with web-based TV apps Covered Parking for 2 Cars – Secure & hassle-free parking Gated Community with Resort-Style Pool & Hot Tub – Heated year-round for extra comfortWelcome to The Crest 9Nestled along the serene coastline, this luxurious beach house offers an idyllic retreat for up to 14 guests, ensuring a memorable stay filled with comfort and relaxation. Spread across four floors, the sleeping arrangements boast unparalleled comfort and privacy, with two master suites each featuring a king-sized bed and private bath, complemented by additional well-appointed guest bedrooms including a bunk room with full-over-full beds and a twin trundle, and another with two twin-over-twin bunk beds. With each space thoughtfully designed and furnished, restful nights are assured, setting the stage for days of seaside bliss.Stepping into the home, guests are greeted by a wealth of amenities designed to enhance their stay. From the panoramic Gulf views visible throughout the property to the private poolside cabana and two rooftop gathering areas with built-in grills, every detail is tailored to create an unforgettable coastal experience. Whether lounging by the fire pit, unwinding in the media room complete with air hockey table and video games, or enjoying the convenience of the second-floor office and dual sets of washer/dryers, every moment promises both comfort and entertainment. With access to YouTube TV and web-based TV apps, along with five adult bikes for exploring the surrounding area, guests can immerse themselves in both relaxation and adventure. Moreover, the community amenities, including a resort-style pool, hot tub, and gated access, ensure a truly indulgent escape, while the proximity to shops, restaurants, and the beach offers convenience and endless opportunities for seaside enjoyment.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (14):Second Floor Master 1: King with private bathThird Floor Master 2: King with private bathSecond Floor Guest BR: King with private bathFirst Floor Bunk Room: Full over Full with Twin Trundle with shared bathSecond Floor Bunk Room: 2 Twin over Twin Bunk Beds (4) with private bathWelcome to Blue Mountain Beach, a hidden gem along Florida’s scenic Highway 30A! Known for its breathtaking white sand beaches, vibrant turquoise waters, and relaxed coastal charm, this community is the perfect destination for those seeking great food, sweet treats, shopping, and outdoor adventures.Start your day with a delicious breakfast at Blue Mountain Bakery, then swing by For the Health of It for quick grocery essentials and organic treats. When it’s time for lunch or dinner, savor fresh seafood and coastal flavors at Red Fish Taco, Shunk Gulley, or Cowgirl Kitchen, all just a short bike ride away. Enjoy some shopping at The Stalls on 30A, where you’ll find unique local treasures and coastal-inspired finds. And when it’s time for something sweet, indulge in homemade ice cream from Blue Mountain Beach Creamery, just a quick stroll from your doorstep.Whether you’re here to unwind on the beach, explore the area, or simply soak in the laid-back 30A lifestyle, you’ve found the perfect place to stay! Show less
